data.long_meaning: Name derived from Old English 'west' meaning 'west' and 'leah' meaning 'meadow'. This name was used to refer to someone living near or from a western meadow.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Westley" could be seen as a reminder of God's presence and intervention in our daily lives. The term 'west' may symbolize the setting sun, which can be seen as a representation of the end of one day and the arrival of a new one. This daily cycle, as well as the broader cycle of the seasons, can serve as a reminder of God's constant presence throughout the natural world and in our lives. The term 'meadow' could be seen as a symbol of fertility, growth, and renewal, further emphasizing the idea of God's presence and His role in the growth and development of His creations.
